about: Avatar builder parts (backlog #10), first set. Run: python3 tools/genart.py avatar tools/batches/avatar1.json  (skips anything already made). White parts are tinted in the game.
base: a cute chibi kid farmer character with a big round head and a small body, completely bald smooth round head with no hair, simple happy face with dot eyes and a small smile, light peach skin, wearing a plain light grey t-shirt and plain light grey shorts, small brown boots, arms relaxed at the sides, standing, body facing toward the bottom left

hair/pigtails.prompt: give the character two pigtails of pure white hair with bangs

hair/short.prompt: give the character short neat pure white hair

hair/curly.prompt: give the character a big round puff of curly pure white hair

hair/ponytail.prompt: give the character pure white hair with bangs on the forehead and one ponytail sticking out behind the head; the face stays fully visible

hair/bun.prompt: give the character pure white hair covering the top of the head, pulled up into one big round bun on top

hair/braids.prompt: give the character pure white hair covering the whole top of the head with a center part, and two long braids hanging down at the sides

hair/long.prompt: give the character long straight pure white hair down past the shoulders

hair/spiky.prompt: give the character short spiky pure white hair

hair/bob.prompt: give the character a chin-length pure white bob haircut with bangs

hair/buzz.prompt: give the character a very short pure white buzz cut

hat/straw.prompt: add a round straw farmer hat on the character's head

hat/cap.prompt: add a pure white baseball cap on the character's head

hat/bonnet.prompt: add a pure white sun bonnet on the character's head

hat/flowercrown.prompt: add a crown of small colorful flowers on the character's head

hat/beanie.prompt: add a pure white knitted beanie hat on the character's head

hat/cowboy.prompt: add a brown cowboy hat on the character's head

hat/crown.prompt: add a small shiny gold crown on the character's head

outfit/overalls.prompt: dress the character in pure white denim farmer overalls: a bib on the chest, two shoulder straps over the shoulders, a front pocket and long legs down to the boots

outfit/dress.prompt: dress the character in a pure white farm dress with puffy short sleeves

outfit/shirt.prompt: dress the character in a pure white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves and pure white pants

outfit/apron.prompt: put a pure white apron over the character's clothes

outfit/bandana.prompt: tie a pure white bandana around the character's neck

outfit/raincoat.prompt: dress the character in a long pure white raincoat with big buttons, covering the whole body down to the knees, both arms in white sleeves

feet/rainboots.prompt: change the boots to tall pure white rain boots

extra/glasses.prompt: add round black glasses on the character's face

extra/bow.prompt: add a big pure white hair bow on top of the character's head
